  "findings": [
    {
      "functional_intent": "Check if a host is reachable by executing a ping command.",
      "untrusted_data_sources": [
        "request.args.get(\"host\", \"\")"
      ],
      "violated_safety_invariant": "Nothing ensures the host parameter is a single shell token; it is interpolated into a command string, allowing shell metacharacters to be executed.",
      "cwe": "CWE-78",
      "title": "Shell metacharacters in ping command",
      "file": "app/diagnostics/network.py",
      "start_line": 5,
      "end_line": 5,
      "sink_expression": "os.system(f\"ping -c 1 {host}\")",
      "severity": "critical",
      "rationale": "The host parameter is taken directly from the request and interpolated into a string passed to os.system. An attacker can provide a value like '127.0.0.1; cat /etc/passwd' to execute arbitrary commands on the server.",
      "evidence_lines": [
        4,
        5
      ],
      "exploitability": "direct"
    }
  ]
}
